Context: Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty was a Hindu dynasty ruling large parts of northern India between the 6th and 11th centuries AD. Gurneel reigned during the late 10th century and is known for his military prowess and successful resistance against invading forces.
Time period: Late 10th century AD
